**💡 Today's learning: "Vitamin C stops you catching colds"**
- 🤔 **What people believe:** A daily vitamin C tablet or fizzy drink keeps colds away all winter.
- 🔬 **The fact:** The US National Institutes of Health says a Cochrane review of trials using at least 200 mg a day found regular vitamin C did not lower the chance of catching a cold in the general population. It only shortened colds a little: about 8% in adults and 14% in children.
- 🎯 **How they fool you:** The idea took off after chemist Linus Pauling promoted it in the 1970s, and supplement and 'immunity' drink makers still lean on it every cold season. A slightly shorter cold is a long way from not catching one.
- **Source:** https://ods.od.nih.gov/factsheets/VitaminC-HealthProfessional/
